source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.5 with Figs. 8.7 and 8.8 and Examples 8.2 to 8.4 (PDF 179-183).

blocks.text: Malus ka law kehta hai: analyzer se guzarne ke baad plane polarized light ki intensity I, analyzer aur polarizer ke transmission axes ke darmiyan angle θ ke cosine ke square ke directly proportional (seedha mutabiq) hoti hai. Yani:
jahan I₀ = analyzer par parne wali polarized light ki intensity (polarizer se guzarne ke baad).

blocks.alt: Baen se daen ek lakeer par: unpolarized light (radial lakeeron ka daira), initial polarizer (khari lakeeron wala kaala disc), I0 intensity wali polarized light (khara dohra teer) aur us ka analyzer ke axis ke parallel (mutawazi) juz (surmai tirchha teer), analyzer (dhaari-daar disc) jis ka axis khari direction (simt) se theta ghooma hai, aur us ke baad I = I0 cos^2 theta wala surmai tirchha teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.7 (a): Malus ke law ka khaaka (kitab ki Figure 8.7 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Asal mein Malus ka law batata hai ke pehli polaroid (polarizer) par parne wali light ki intensity aur doosri polaroid (analyzer) se guzarne ke baad ki intensity mein kya relation hai (Fig. 8.7(a)). Analyzer bhi ek polarizer hi hai jo pehle polarizer ke baad rakha jata hai. Analyzer ko ghumane se polarized light ki intensity badalti hai; is se light ko aur kam kiya ja sakta hai aur polarizer ke muqable mein analyzer ka angle badal kar intensity set ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Polarizer ke baad light vertical direction mein polarized hai (intensity I₀). Analyzer ka axis θ par ghooma hua hai, is liye sirf woh hissa guzarta hai jo analyzer ke axis ke parallel hai. Intensity I = I₀ cos²θ: θ = 0 par poori light, θ = 90° par bilkul nahi.

Kuch transparent crystalline materials (shaffaf crystal wale maadde), jaise tourmaline aur calcite, light ki vibration ko sirf ek plane tak confine (mehdood) kar sakte hain. Aise materials polaroids kehlate hain; un ki crystal structure (banawat) mein ek khaas direction (directionality) hoti hai. Light natural (qudrati) processes, jaise reflection, refraction aur scattering (bikharna), se bhi polarized ho sakti hai.
Agar polarized light ke samne polaroid ka tukra ghumayein to guzarne wali light ki intensity badalti hai. Is ki wajah pehle polarizer aur doosre polarizer ke axis ke darmiyan angle hai.

blocks.alt: Ek nuqte se: plane of polarizer ke saath khara teer A0; us se theta zawiye par plane of analyzer ke saath teer A0 cos theta; aur us ke perpendicular (90° par) teer A0 sin theta. Dashed lakeerein mustateel (rectangle) poora karti hain jis ka qutr (diagonal) A0 hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.7 (b): Plane polarized light ke amplitude ko ajza mein taqseem karna (kitab ki Figure 8.7 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jab A₀ amplitude wali polarized light analyzer par angle θ se parti hai to woh do components mein resolve ho (toot) jati hai: A₀cosθ aur A₀sinθ (Fig. 8.7(b)). A₀sinθ wala hissa analyzer absorb (jazb) kar leta hai, aur sirf A₀cosθ guzarta hai. Is liye guzarne wali light ka amplitude A:

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: A₀ do hisson (components) mein resolve hota hai: analyzer ke axis ke saath A₀ cos θ (yeh guzarta hai) aur us ke perpendicular A₀ sin θ (yeh absorb ho jata hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 8.7(b) mein dono lakeeron par 'Plane of polarizer' likha hai. Tirchhi lakeer asal mein analyzer ka plane hai, is liye hamari figure mein us par 'Plane of analyzer' likha hai.
Intensity amplitude ka square hoti hai, is liye:
Yahan I₀ analyzer par parne wali polarized light ki intensity hai.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Crossed (ek doosre se 90° par) polarizers se light nahi guzarti.

blocks.alt: Kai satahon mein waves (lehrein) aur teeron wali unpolarized beam Polarizer-1 tak aati hai, jo khari jhiriyon wala frame hai. Dono polarizers ke darmiyan sirf khari wave (lehar) bachti hai. Polarizer-2, horizontal (leta hua) jhiriyon wala frame, use rok deta hai.
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 180): Crossed polarizers se guzarti light (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Is equation se θ ki do extreme (aakhri hadd wali) conditions nikalti hain:

items: Agar θ = 0° ho to I = I₀: analyzer se utni hi intensity guzarti hai jitni polarizer se guzri thi.
Agar θ = 90° ho to I = 0: light poori extinguish ho (bujh) jati hai, analyzer se kuch nahi guzarta.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehla polarizer sirf vertical vibration guzarta hai. Doosre ka axis horizontal hai, yani pehle ke perpendicular (crossed); vertical vibration ka horizontal hissa zero hai, is liye aage koi light nahi jati (Malus: θ = 90°, I = 0).
